'''Syla Trasker''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force Adept]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Born to a farmer and chemist father, Syla Trasker's mother died soon after giving birth. During Trasker's childhood, she was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], causing her father to become extremely protective of her in fear of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When her father discovered a [[dolina]] ring seed in freight containing a variety of seeds purchased form a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], he gifted the curiosity to his daughter. When the girl's abilities attracted the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], she hid in her father's laboratory as the Imperial agents executed her father in cold blood. Sliding the ring seed on to her finger, Trasker felt the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] envelope her and give her preternatural speed. Racing away, Trasker made her way in life until she was old enough to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. An accomplished [[Force Adept]], Trasker wore the ring seed around her neck on a chain, its incredible weight unfelt by her.<ref name="NoP" />
